project.name: oxiguitar-midi
project.description: The OxiGuitar MIDI plugin: plays every track with a SoundFont, DLS or SFZ sound set, the user's or the system's. It provides a custom SFZ synthesizer (256 voices) and uses rustysynth for SoundFont synthesis.

layers.name: Core Library
layers.description: The OxiGuitar plugin interface — the lib.rs entry point that defines MidiPlugin, implements the plugin contract, and re-exports all public modules.

layers.name: SFZ Engine
layers.description: The custom SFZ synthesizer engine — 9 files covering SFZ text parsing, region definitions, instrument building, key mapping, sample loading/decoding, voice management (sampler), and sinc resampling.

layers.name: SoundFont Support
layers.description: SoundFont 2, SoundFont 3, and DLS format parsers — converts these sound set formats into structures usable by rustysynth for MIDI playback.

layers.name: Playback Engine
layers.description: The main MIDI playback runner — manages the Player state machine, vibrato, and coordinates the SFZ sampler for real-time audio rendering.

layers.name: Format Utilities
layers.description: RIFF binary format utilities — chunk reading, list traversal, and binary data access used by both SF2 and DLS parsers.

layers.name: Settings and Selection
layers.description: User-facing configuration — sound set discovery (sets.rs), per-role sound selection (settings.rs), track-level overrides (track.rs), and set metadata/labeling (info.rs).

layers.name: Infrastructure
layers.description: CI/CD pipelines and GitHub configuration — four GitHub Actions workflows (CI, listening tests, publishing, releases) plus Dependabot configuration.

layers.name: Configuration
layers.description: Build and project configuration — Cargo.toml (dependencies, features, lints), manifest.json (plugin metadata), and Rust tooling configs (clippy, deny, rustfmt).

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project documentation — README, CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING guidelines, CLAUDE.md for AI-assisted development, and the pull request template.

layers.name: Testing
layers.description: Test infrastructure — contract tests validating the .oxp plugin interface, real-time integration tests exercising the SFZ sampler, the DCO sign-off script, and SFZ test fixtures.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Read the README to understand what this plugin does: it plays OxiGuitar guitar tablature tracks using MIDI with SoundFont, DLS, or SFZ sound sets. It ships with a custom 256-voice SFZ synthesizer and uses rustysynth for SoundFont synthesis.

tour.title: Plugin Entry Point & Module Organization
tour.description: Examine src/lib.rs — the OxiGuitar plugin contract. This is the entry point that defines the MidiPlugin trait implementation, re-exports all public modules, and wires together the SFZ engine, soundfont parsers, settings, and playback engine.

tour.title: MIDI Playback Engine
tour.description: Study src/play.rs — the main playback runner. It manages the Player state machine, handles note-on/note-off events from the MIDI stream, coordinates vibrato, and drives the SFZ sampler for real-time audio rendering. This is where MIDI events become audible audio.

tour.title: SFZ Engine: Text Parsing & Regions
tour.description: Explore src/sfz/text.rs and src/sfz/region.rs — the SFZ parser that reads SFZ text files, extracts global and drum groups, parses amplitude envelopes, pitch envelopes, key ranges, and other SFZ2 opcodes into structured Region objects.

tour.title: SFZ Engine: Instruments & Key Mapping
tour.description: Review src/sfz/instrument.rs and src/sfz/maps.rs — how parsed regions are assembled into instruments, and how MIDI key numbers are mapped to articulations with support for key ranges, velocity layers, and group-based priority.

tour.title: SFZ Engine: Sample Loading & Resampling
tour.description: Look at src/sfz/sample.rs and src/sfz/sinc.rs — how audio samples are loaded from files, decoded (FLAC, OGG, WAV), and resampled using sinc interpolation to match the target sample rate while preserving audio quality.

tour.title: SFZ Engine: Voice Manager & Sampler
tour.description: Study src/sfz/sampler.rs — the most complex SFZ file at ~2000 lines. It implements the voice manager (allocating, triggering, and releasing voices), handles amplitude envelopes, pitch modulation, and routes audio output through the audio callback.

tour.title: SFZ Engine: High-Level Loader
tour.description: Review src/sfz/mod.rs — the barrel module that ties together text parsing, region building, instrument construction, and sample loading into a single load() API. This is the public interface for loading an SFZ instrument file.

tour.title: SoundFont & DLS Format Support
tour.description: Examine src/sf2.rs, src/sf3.rs, and src/dls.rs — parsers for SoundFont 2, SoundFont 3, and DLS sound set formats. These convert proprietary binary formats into a unified representation that rustysynth can use for MIDI synthesis. They share src/riff.rs for RIFF chunk reading.

tour.title: Settings & Sound Selection
tour.description: Explore src/settings.rs, src/sets.rs, src/info.rs, and src/track.rs — the user-facing configuration layer. Settings discovers available sound sets, assigns them to MIDI channels (roles), allows per-track overrides, and manages set metadata and labeling.

tour.title: Testing & Validation
tour.description: Review the test suite: tests/contract.rs validates the .oxp plugin interface contract, and tests/realtime.rs exercises the SFZ sampler in real-time to catch audio glitches. Also check scripts/check-dco.sh for contributor sign-off enforcement.

tour.title: Build Configuration & CI
tour.description: Look at Cargo.toml for dependencies (oxiguitar-plugin, rustysynth, lewton, claxon), deny.toml for dependency audit rules, and the GitHub Actions workflows (ci.yml, listening.yml, publish.yml, release.yml) that drive continuous integration and plugin publishing.
